body_markdown: # AI Proof Weekend Pool Pricing October 2026  <!-- H1 will be auto-set, but keep for reference -->  ## Understanding Hourly Rates  - **Base hourly rate**: start at $25 per hour for off‑peak weekends.  - **Mid‑tier hourly rate**: $35 per hour for standard weekend slots.  - **Premium hourly rate**: $50 per hour for prime time (Saturday 2 pm–8 pm).  ### Minimum Booking Requirements  - Most hosts require a 2‑hour minimum for any weekend reservation.  - Some premium locations enforce a 3‑hour minimum during peak hours.  - Offer a “half‑day” package (4 hours) at a slight discount versus booking hourly.  ## Peak Hours and Seasonal Adjustments  - **Peak hours**: Saturday 2 pm–8 pm and Sunday 10 am–4 pm; add 20 % surcharge.  - **Off‑peak**: Early morning (before 12 pm) and late evening (after 8 pm) are 10 % cheaper.  - **Seasonal spikes**: Summer months (June–August) increase rates by 15 %; winter months may drop 10 % to attract bookings.  ### Example Pricing Table  | Time Slot | Base Rate | Adjusted Rate | |---------
